entries.name: Hero's Sword
entries.content:
The Claiomh Solais, also known as the Sword of Light, is an artifact of legend, said to have been bestowed upon the chosen heroes of old by the celestial beings themselves. Forged from a material not of this world, the sword possesses an ethereal quality, shimmering under any form of light as if radiating a soft luminescence of its own. It is a masterpiece of craftsmanship, balancing perfectly in the hand, the hilt wrapped in leather of the rarest beast, providing a firm, unyielding grip to its wielder.

The blade, as long as a grown man's arm and as wide as a hand's breadth, is of an unearthly silver, so pure and so bright that it appears almost liquid in its luster. It tapers elegantly from the hilt to the point, the edge honed so fine that it could split a hair. Etched along the flat of the blade are intricate runes of an ancient language, their meaning lost to time but their power unquestionable.

The cross-guard is fashioned from the same otherworldly material, the metal twisted into elaborate designs of celestial bodies - stars, comets, and the moon, reflecting the heavenly origins of the blade. At the very center, where the blade and the cross-guard meet, is set a single, mesmerizing gemstone that seems to contain a galaxy within its depths.
